headline: There is a verified, dated reason to book THIS WEEK rather than later: Wynn's public Cyber Exclusive rate must be booked between November 20 and December 4, 2026, and it is $156 per night cheaper than the same room's Flexible Getaway rate for the exact Feb 15–22, 2027 stay.

rate_calendar.hotel: Resorts World Las Vegas — Las Vegas Hilton tower
rate_calendar.source: Official booking engine month calendar, February 2027, 2 adults
rate_calendar.basis_warning: These are the engine's per-arrival-date 'from' prices for February 2027. The same calendar prints TWO contradictory captions — 'Calendar pricing excludes daily resort fee and taxes' AND 'Calendar pricing includes $55 daily resort fee and excludes taxes'. Fee treatment is therefore UNRESOLVED. Summing seven consecutive nights is an INDICATIVE comparison of date windows, not a booking quote.
rate_calendar.finding: On this one hotel's official calendar, shifting check-in from Mon Feb 15 to Thu Feb 18 lowers the indicative 7-night room subtotal from $1,942 to $1,632 — about $310 (16%) less — while still starting inside the preferred part of the window. Feb 16 and Feb 17 are the two most expensive weeknights ($404 each) in the whole month.
rate_calendar.limits: Only February 2027 was captured. March 2027 was not retrieved, so no claim is made about March being cheaper or dearer. Only one hotel publishes a calendar this way; other engines returned a single stay average.

date_facts.fact: Monday, February 15, 2027 is Washington's Birthday (Presidents' Day), a U.S. federal holiday.
date_facts.implication: Your preferred check-in is the holiday itself, at the end of a three-day weekend. Expect elevated demand and rates across that weekend.

date_facts.fact: Sunday, February 14, 2027 is Valentine's Day and immediately precedes the holiday weekend.
date_facts.implication: Feb 13–15 is a compressed peak. The Resorts World calendar shows $414 on Sat Feb 13.

date_facts.fact: MGM Resorts' official engine states you can only book stays up to 14 nights online; longer stays require calling 866.761.7111.
date_facts.implication: A 14-night trip is the maximum bookable online at MGM properties — it fits the brief's upper bound exactly, with no margin.

date_facts.fact: Wynn's Cyber rates allow stays of 1–14 nights (public) or 2–14 nights (member).
date_facts.implication: Both a 7-night and a 14-night trip qualify for the sale.

date_facts.fact: Bellagio Conservatory: Lunar New Year display Jan 9 – Mar 6, 2027; DARK Mar 7–12; Spring from Mar 13.
date_facts.implication: A February trip sees the Lunar New Year installation. Avoid Mar 7–12 if the Conservatory matters to you.

date_facts.fact: Red Rock Canyon requires a timed-entry vehicle reservation 8 AM – 5 PM, Oct 1 – May 31.
date_facts.implication: Book the Red Rock slot for your chosen day before you finalise the daily itinerary.

date_facts.fact: Valley of Fire's annual trail closures run May 15 – Sep 30, and its maintenance closure is Dec 1–14.
date_facts.implication: Feb/Mar is one of the best windows of the year for this park — all listed trails are open.

date_facts.fact: The Neon Museum will charge extra for arriving outside your selected ticket time from January 1, 2027.
date_facts.implication: Book a specific Neon Museum slot and keep to it.

not_verified: No official 2027 convention/event calendar for Las Vegas was retrieved, so the cause of the Feb 16–17 rate spike is unknown.
No March 2027 rate calendar was captured.
No hotel published a full tax-inclusive 7-night total except South Point, which includes fees but excludes taxes.
No source was found that predicts future rate movement, so 'wait and it will get cheaper' cannot be supported.
